THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 2 · Goblin blind
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Across the stream, the briars are thick enough to swallow the path. A board creaks faintly behind them, then goes still.

The vegetation interrupts your view of whatever lies beyond it. The stream remains an obvious landmark beside the approach, but the brief creak gives you a reason to watch the cover rather than hurry past it.

Ask the players

“Do you cross, watch, call out, or try another path?”

Choices

Stealth, scouting, a rush across the stream, a distraction, or retreat can all change the position of this fight.
